description.zh: 指定要查询的用户显示姓名。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The display name of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询用户列表的堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose users you want to query.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh: 指定要查询的用户的手机号码。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The mobile phone number of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。

指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
指定要查询用户列表的堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose users you want to query.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户的来源。取值：
- **Local**：本地用户
- **Ram**：RAM用户
- **AD**：AD用户
- **LDAP**：LDAP用户
description.en:
The type of the user that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local user.

- **Ram**: a Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

- **AD**: an Active Directory (AD)-authenticated user.

- **LDAP**: a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)-authenticated user.

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户的唯一标识。仅支持精确查询。
> 该参数是堡垒机用户对应的RAM用户的唯一标识。新创建用户来源为RAM用户（即**Source**取值为**Ram**）时，该参数生效。您可以调用访问控制的[ListUsers](~~28684~~)接口从返回数据**UserId**获取该参数。
description.en:
The unique ID of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

> This parameter uniquely identifies a RAM user of the bastion host. This parameter is valid if **Source** is set to **Ram**. You can call the [ListUsers](~~28684~~) operation in RAM to obtain the unique ID of the user from the **UserId** response parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListUserGroups](~~204509~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the user group to which the user you want to query belongs.

> You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~204509~~) operation to query the user group ID.

description.zh: 指定要查询的用户登录名称。仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The logon name of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
指定要查询的用户状态。取值：
- **Normal**：正常状态
- **Frozen**：被锁定状态
- **Expired**：已过期状态
description.en:
The state of the user that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The user is in normal state.

- **Frozen**: The user is locked.

- **Expired**: The user has expired.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-users --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --user-name abc --display-name testuser --source Local --mobile 13599990000 --user-state Normal --source-user-id 1227489245380000 --user-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListUsers --region cn-hangzhou --UserName abc --UserState Normal --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber 1 --SourceUserId 1227489245380000 --UserGroupId 1 --DisplayName testuser --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Mobile 13599990000 --Source Local
